description: Mark secret values sensitive, so they accept `Redacted` and never print in logs or errors. The spec has no `x-sensitive` marks, and the values are named `value` or are map values, which no default name pattern matches: `value` of PUT /v1/apps/{project}/secrets/{name} (putSecret), the `set` map of PATCH /v1/apps/{project}/secrets (patchSecrets) and of `secrets_patch`, and the `secrets` map of PUT /v1/apps/{project} (putApp). The spec's own descriptions: "Per-app secrets. Names can be listed, values never come back", and "Secrets are not allowed in a build's `spec` (it is stored in plain text)".
